binary: /home/noah/src/aprender/target/release/apr v0.32.0 + PR #1628 H4 fix (ChatML wrap + extract_python_code_block)
summary: H4 fix produces pass@1 = 80.49% (132/164) — a 46pp improvement from §65 baseline (34.15%) but still 4.31pp below the 84.80% effective SHIP-005 floor. SHIP-005 stays PARTIAL; gap is now refinement-scale.

interpretation.model_capability_confirmed: pass@100 = 100% — model can solve every problem given enough samples
interpretation.harness_methodology_was_the_main_issue: §66 H4 hypothesis confirmed: raw-continuation vs ChatML was the root cause of the prior 50pp gap
interpretation.remaining_gap_is_refinement_scale: 4.31pp is now within the band where small refinements (extraction robustness, sampling, quantization) can close it

r1_extraction_robustness.description: Some completions may not be wrapped in ```python ... ``` (model may emit raw code, or extra non-code text inside the fence). Verify by sampling failed problems.
r1_extraction_robustness.investigation_plan: Capture full assistant responses for 5-10 failed problems; inspect extraction success

r2_function_targeted_extraction.description: Current extract_python_code_block returns the FIRST fenced block. If model emits multiple fences (e.g., setup + solution + example), wrong block could be returned.
r2_function_targeted_extraction.investigation_plan: Add entry_point-aware extraction: prefer the block containing `def {entry_point}(`

r3_q4k_quantization_loss.description: Canonical teacher is Q4K-quantized. Published Qwen 88.4% may be FP16. Q4K typically loses 1-3pp on HumanEval.
r3_q4k_quantization_loss.investigation_plan: Compare same model in FP16 (safetensors) vs Q4K (apr) on subset of failed problems

r4_sampling_refinement.description: Temperature 0.0 + top_k=1 is strict greedy. Some HumanEval problems benefit from temp 0.2 + multiple samples even at pass@1 evaluation.
r4_sampling_refinement.investigation_plan: Try temperature=0.2, samples=3, take majority; compare

methodology_lesson_14_new.name: Near-miss results bound refinement scope
methodology_lesson_14_new.description: A near-miss outcome (4.31pp below floor) is fundamentally different from a far-miss (50pp below floor). The far-miss indicates a methodology issue; the near-miss indicates a refinement issue. SHIP-005's path: §65 50pp gap → H4 fix closes 92% of the gap → §67 4.31pp gap is refinement-scale (R1-R4 candidates each could close it alone or in combination).
methodology_lesson_14_new.generalises: Lesson #11 (multi-PR cascades): this confirms a single fix may not close the full gap but may bound it to a smaller cascade.
